pages.text: Catch a Cod, Salmon or Bluegill with a fishing rod.

pages.title: Got a Bite!
pages.text: Start fishing with a real ordinary catch.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Use an available fishing-system rod; the ordinary vanilla rod is disabled in this pack. Catch the fish yourself rather than buying it.

pages.title: Land a Tide fish
pages.text: Hold and release right-click to cast, then click in the correct minigame region. Species differ in strength and movement, without requiring a separate quest for every fish.

pages.title: Separate traits grant small experience from genuine mature harves
pages.text: Separate traits grant small experience from genuine mature harvests and real catches after their thresholds and cooldowns. Empty actions do not yield endless experience.
